title: Webhook receiver token validation disabled by default + config-key mismatch
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Steve Sanderson; component: WebhookClient/
rationale: Replaces the broken root-key bool.TryParse with the section-bound IOptions<WebhookClientOptions>.Value.ValidateToken (the previously dead property becomes the single source of truth), defaults the property to true (fail closed), and ships ValidateToken: true in appsettings.json. Guards themselves unchanged — they now actually run. Token secrecy is f029's concern; this restores the control's function.
variants_checked: ValidateToken read in exactly one production site plus tests (updated to the section key); options binding registration confirmed at Extensions.cs:15; AddWebhook.razor unaffected.
bypass_considered: Tokenless or wrong-token posts now 400 and do not persist; the committed public token still forges valid-looking hooks (f029); stale deployments with the old root key fail closed since nothing reads it.
test_note: WebhookEndpointsRejectHooksWhenValidationIsNotConfigured asserts both endpoints 400 and nothing persists with no config; existing test updated to bind options and use the section key.
review_reason: Fixes both the wrong-key lookup and the fail-open default at the cited line; every hunk on the data-flow path; only nit is the token still read from raw IConfiguration.
